title: Huawei found guilty of stealing trade secrets

claims.claim: Bir jüri, Huawei'yi ABD ticari sırlarını çalmaktan suçlu buldu.

evidence.quote: A jury has found Huawei guilty of stealing US trade secrets
Huawei has been found guilty of conspiracy to steal trade secrets
Huawei Technologies has been found guilty of bank fraud and conspiracy to steal trade secrets by a US jury
Huawei is guilty of conspiracy to steal trade secrets, US jury rules

claims.claim: Huawei, T-Mobile, Cisco ve Motorola gibi şirketlerden kaynak kodu ve özel teknoloji çalmakla suçlandı.

evidence.quote: accused the Chinese telecom giant of stealing source code and proprietary technology from several companies, including T-Mobile, Cisco, and Motorola.

The verdict, handed down in a federal court in New York, concludes a years-long legal battle that accused the Chinese telecom giant of stealing source code and proprietary technology from several companies, including T-Mobile, Cisco, and Motorola.

claims.claim: Huawei, banka dolandırıcılığı suçundan suçlu bulundu.

evidence.quote: The Chinese telecom giant was also found guilty of bank fraud.
Huawei has been found guilty of conspiracy to steal trade secrets and bank fraud
Huawei Technologies has been found guilty of bank fraud and conspiracy to steal trade secrets by a US jury

claims.claim: ABD Adalet Bakanlığı, 2018 yılında Huawei'ye karşı bir ceza davası iddianamesi hazırladı.

evidence.quote: The Department of Justice’s 2018 criminal indictment against Huawei came to light
The Department of Justice’s 2018 criminal indictment against Huawei came to light following the arrest of the company’s CFO, Wanzhou Meng

claims.claim: ABD hükümeti, ulusal güvenlik endişeleri nedeniyle 2019 yılında Huawei'yi kara listeye aldı.

evidence.quote: The US government blacklisted Huawei in 2019 over national security concerns.

claims.claim: Jüri, Huawei'yi toplam 12 suçlamanın 10'undan suçlu buldu.

evidence.quote: In total, the jury found Huawei guilty of 10 of 12 criminal counts
Jurors in a Brooklyn court found Huawei guilty of 10 out of 12 counts

claims.claim: Huawei'nin ceza duruşmasının 14 Eylül 2027 tarihinde yapılması planlanıyor.

evidence.quote: Huawei’s sentencing is set for September 14th, 2027

claims.claim: Huawei sözcüsü, suçlamaların yasal veya olgusal bir dayanağı olmadığını belirterek karara itiraz etmeyi planladıklarını açıkladı.

evidence.quote: In a statement to NBC News, a Huawei spokesperson said the charges are “without legal or factual merit” and that it plans to appeal the decision.
Huawei attorney Brian Heberlig told AP the company planned to appeal its convictions.
